import Mathlib

structure BipartiteGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BipartiteGraph.well_formed (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.size (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.has_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Prop :=
  colors.size = g.size ∧
  ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v →
    u < colors.size → v < colors.size → colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false

def BipartiteGraph.is_bipartite (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ colors, g.is_valid_coloring colors

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_precond (graph : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Boolean test that the two endpoints of one edge got different colours. -/
def edgeOk (c : Array Bool) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  c.getD u false != c.getD v false

/-- Total certifier: every edge of `g` is bichromatic under `c`. -/
def allEdgesOk (g : BipartiteGraph) (c : Array Bool) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).all fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).all fun v => edgeOk c u v

/-- One fuel-bounded BFS wave: pop `u`, colour its uncoloured out-neighbours with the
opposite colour and enqueue them. Fuel only bounds the work; the result is a candidate
that is certified afterwards by `allEdgesOk`. -/
def bfsStep (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array (Option Bool)) (q : List Nat) :
    Nat → Array (Option Bool)
  | 0 => colors
  | fuel + 1 =>
    match q with
    | [] => colors
    | u :: rest =>
      let cu := (colors.getD u (some false)).getD false
      let res := (g.adj.getD u #[]).foldl
        (fun (acc : Array (Option Bool) × List Nat) v =>
          match acc.1.getD v (some false) with
          | some _ => acc
          | none => (acc.1.setIfInBounds v (some (!cu)), acc.2 ++ [v]))
        (colors, ([] : List Nat))
      bfsStep g res.1 (rest ++ res.2) fuel

/-- Restart BFS at every still-uncoloured vertex, so disconnected graphs are covered. -/
def bfsAll (g : BipartiteGraph) : Array (Option Bool) :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).foldl
    (fun colors u =>
      match colors.getD u (some false) with
      | some _ => colors
      | none =>
        bfsStep g (colors.setIfInBounds u (some false)) [u]
          (g.adj.size * (g.adj.size + 1) + 1))
    (List.replicate g.adj.size (none : Option Bool)).toArray

/-- The BFS candidate colouring. -/
def bfsColor (g : BipartiteGraph) : Array Bool :=
  (bfsAll g).map fun o => o.getD false

/-- All colour vectors of a given length. -/
def allLists : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 =>
    (allLists n).map (fun l => false :: l) ++ (allLists n).map (fun l => true :: l)

/-- Complete search: the first colour vector of length `n` that certifies. -/
def searchColoring (g : BipartiteGraph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  ((allLists g.adj.size).map List.toArray).find? fun c => allEdgesOk g c

/-- BFS fast path, certified; complete search only as a fallback. -/
def solve (g : BipartiteGraph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  if (bfsColor g).size = g.size ∧ allEdgesOk g (bfsColor g) = true then
    some (bfsColor g)
  else searchColoring g

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def check_bipartite (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  solve graph
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_postcond (graph : BipartiteGraph) (result : Option (Array Bool))
    (_ : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some colors => graph.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ graph.is_bipartite
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem allEdgesOk_iff (g : BipartiteGraph) (c : Array Bool) :
    allEdgesOk g c = true ↔
      ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v → c.getD u false ≠ c.getD v false := by
  constructor
  · intro h u v he
    obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := he
    have h1 := List.all_eq_true.mp h u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
    simp only at h1
    have h2 := List.all_eq_true.mp h1 v (by simpa using hv)
    simpa [edgeOk, bne_iff_ne] using h2
  · intro h
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro u hu
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro v hv
    have he : g.has_edge u v := ⟨List.mem_range.mp hu, by simpa using hv⟩
    simpa [edgeOk, bne_iff_ne] using h u v he

theorem length_of_mem_allLists :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Bool), l ∈ allLists n → l.length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro l hl; simp only [allLists, List.mem_singleton] at hl; simp [hl]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    simp only [allLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at hl
    rcases hl with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ | ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ <;> simp [ih t ht]

theorem mem_allLists :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Bool), l.length = n → l ∈ allLists n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [allLists]
    | cons a t => simp at hl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    cases l with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons b t =>
      have ht : t.length = n := by simpa using hl
      simp only [allLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
      cases b
      · exact Or.inl ⟨t, ih t ht, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨t, ih t ht, rfl⟩

/-- A certified candidate really is a valid colouring. -/
theorem valid_of_ok (g : BipartiteGraph) (c : Array Bool)
    (hs : c.size = g.size) (hok : allEdgesOk g c = true) :
    g.is_valid_coloring c := by
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  intro u v he _ _
  exact (allEdgesOk_iff g c).mp hok u v he

theorem searchColoring_some (g : BipartiteGraph) (c : Array Bool)
    (h : searchColoring g = some c) : g.is_valid_coloring c := by
  have hmem := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h
  have hok : allEdgesOk g c = true := by simpa using List.find?_some h
  rw [List.mem_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hmem
  refine valid_of_ok g _ ?_ hok
  simpa [BipartiteGraph.size] using length_of_mem_allLists _ l hl

theorem searchColoring_none (g : BipartiteGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (h : searchColoring g = none) : ¬ g.is_bipartite := by
  rintro ⟨d, hsize, hedge⟩
  have hd : d ∈ (allLists g.adj.size).map List.toArray := by
    rw [List.mem_map]
    refine ⟨d.toList, mem_allLists _ _ ?_, by simp⟩
    simpa [BipartiteGraph.size] using hsize
  have hok : allEdgesOk g d = true := by
    refine (allEdgesOk_iff g d).mpr ?_
    intro u v he
    have hu : u < d.size := by
      simpa [hsize, BipartiteGraph.size] using he.1
    have hv : v < d.size := by
      have := hwf u he.1 v he.2
      simpa [hsize, BipartiteGraph.size] using this
    exact hedge u v he hu hv
  exact absurd hok (by simpa using List.find?_eq_none.mp h d hd)

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem check_bipartite_postcond_satisfied (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) :
    check_bipartite_postcond graph (check_bipartite graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  show check_bipartite_postcond graph (solve graph) h_precond
  unfold solve
  split
  · next hc =>
    exact valid_of_ok graph _ hc.1 hc.2
  · next =>
    cases hs : searchColoring graph with
    | some c => exact searchColoring_some graph c hs
    | none => exact searchColoring_none graph h_precond hs
  -- !benchmark @end proof
